scope: Content durability and retry; owned shared bootstrap bytes; exact-scope control import validation; preserved completion authority and shared raster guard
assertions: Content directory synchronization must succeed before catalog publication, including reuse of an orphaned existing digest on retry. Repeated failure cannot publish logical assets.
Bootstrap copies are owned synchronously and shared by digest; per-record metadata/digest/media checks remain. Initialization releases retained temporary copies.

Import facade exposes only self-contained validation, denies catalog asset/content access, binds exact canonical scope and shares the existing ready/validation guard. Host does not durably authorize control validation.
Real host regression covers successful archive/content, malformed content/archive, byte-identical catalog, preserved unauthorized scopes after reopen, and concurrent guard sharing.
priorFinding: Initial repair skipped re-syncing an existing content file on retry; repaired and regression extended before this verdict.
